branding.title: Company logo
branding.desc: Shown in the title block of every sheet, in PDF and XLSX exports and on the project card.
branding.default_desc: Every new project starts with this logo. Projects you already have keep their own.
branding.default_on: New projects start with this logo
branding.zone: Logo area: click to choose a file or drop one here
branding.drop: Drop a logo here or click to choose a file
branding.hint: Best: a PNG with a transparent background, at least 600 px wide. The logo is fitted into the owner cell of the title block (about 20 × 12 mm) without stretching; wide logos up to 10:1 work best.
branding.err.too_large: The file is too large: use a picture under 20 MB and 8192 px on a side.
branding.err.unsupported: This file type is not supported: choose a PNG or JPG picture.
branding.err.corrupt: The file cannot be read: it may be damaged or saved by another program.
branding.err.empty: The picture is fully transparent: choose another file.
branding.err.aspect: The picture is too long and thin: a logo should be at most 10 times wider than tall, or the other way round.
